title: script.create_script_version input
description: Appends a script version for an episode's script. It is a draft, and the artifacts it cites must exist: an invented id fails the stage.

episodeId.description: The episode whose script this version belongs to.

basedOnVersionId.description: The version this one revises, or empty for the first.

storySkeletonVersionId.description: The skeleton version this script was written from.

adaptationStrategyVersionId.description: The strategy version this script followed.

summary.description: What this version contains, in a sentence or two.

changeReason.description: Why this version exists, in one sentence.
